verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud markets 'Grafana Assistant' and natural-language understanding of production systems (grafana-docs-8, grafana-docs-45), plus a knowledge graph explicitly enabling insight generation 'no complex queries required' (grafana-docs-44), and supports AI agent connectivity via MCP servers (grafana-docs-7, grafana-probe-4) which would allow natural-language operation through an agent intermediary. However, the core product's native UI is dashboard/query-based (PromQL/LogQL), not natural-language-first, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming the Grafana Assistant's natural-language command capability works well in practice. missing for 10: hands-on/independent validation of Grafana Assistant's NL command execution, detail on scope/limits of natural-language operations vs traditional query languages.
